scope: Ingredient and station reachability with explicit native/world/boss seeds. No proof of rates, self-sustaining production, stage integration or runtime recipe acceptance.
assumptions: Water, crops, mobs, mineral seeds and boss items are world acquisition boundaries.
Charged creeper capture bootstraps lightning bottles; Channeler supplies subsequent lightning.
Four AE2 presses and generator lens/frame blocks are retained seeds.
Fission, SPS, Source collection and Matter Condenser behavior are non-JSON machine rules.
Imbuement has native passive Source generation.
Installed stages/quests are independently managed and not simulated here.
